<!-- 1. Panggil library ONNX Runtime Web -->
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort.min.js"></script>

<div style="font-family: sans-serif; max-width: 650px;">
  <h3>Monitoring CCTV Truk Overdimension</h3>
  <p id="status-model" style="color: orange; font-weight: bold;">
    Menghubungkan ke model di Hugging Face...
  </p>

  <!-- Tampilan Video CCTV -->
  <video id="cctv-video" autoplay playsinline muted width="640" height="360" 
         crossorigin="anonymous" style="background: #000; border-radius: 8px;"></video>

  <!-- Opsional: Tombol tes pakai Webcam atau Upload Gambar untuk uji coba -->
  <div style="margin: 10px 0;">
    <button onclick="aktifkanWebcam()">Tes Pakai Kamera/Webcam</button>
    <input type="file" id="upload-tes" accept="image/*" onchange="tesUploadGambar(event)" />
  </div>

  <!-- Kotak Hasil Deteksi -->
  <div id="hasil-deteksi" style="padding: 12px; background: #f3f4f6; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 18px;">
    Menunggu deteksi...
  </div>
</div>

<script>
// GANTI 2 LINK INI DENGAN LINK RESOLVE/MAIN HUGGING FACE ANDA
const MODEL_URL = "https://huggingface.co/spaces/monkingya/deteksi_truk_overdimension/resolve/main/best_yolo_cls.onnx";
const JSON_URL  = "https://huggingface.co/spaces/monkingya/deteksi_truk_overdimension/resolve/main/class_mapping.json";

const INPUT_SIZE = 224; // Resolusi input YOLOv8-cls (ubah ke 640 jika saat training memakai imgsz=640)
let session = null;
let classMap = {};

const video = document.getElementById("cctv-video");
const statusEl = document.getElementById("status-model");
const hasilEl = document.getElementById("hasil-deteksi");
const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d", { willReadFrequently: true });
canvas.width = INPUT_SIZE;
canvas.height = INPUT_SIZE;

// 1. Fungsi memuat JSON & Model ONNX dari Hugging Face saat web dibuka
async function konekKeHuggingFace() {
  try {
    // Ambil file class_mapping.json
    const resJson = await fetch(JSON_URL);
    const rawMap = await resJson.json();

    // Otomatis sesuaikan format JSON baik {"0": "nama_kelas"} maupun {"nama_kelas": 0}
    for (const [key, val] of Object.entries(rawMap)) {
      if (!isNaN(key)) {
        classMap[Number(key)] = val;
      } else {
        classMap[Number(val)] = key;
      }
    }

    // Load model best_yolo_cls.onnx
    session = await ort.InferenceSession.create(MODEL_URL, {
      executionProviders: ["wasm"]
    });

    statusEl.style.color = "green";
    statusEl.innerText = "Terhubung ke Hugging Face! Model siap mendeteksi.";

    // Jalankan deteksi otomatis setiap 500ms (0,5 detik) jika video CCTV aktif
    setInterval(() => {
      if (video.readyState >= 2 && !video.paused) {
        jalankanPrediksi(video);
      }
    }, 500);

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Detail Error:", err);
    statusEl.style.color = "red";
    statusEl.innerText = "Gagal memuat model. Pastikan Space Hugging Face berstatus Public.";
  }
}

// 2. Fungsi memproses gambar/video menjadi prediksi kelas
async function jalankanPrediksi(sumberGambar) {
  if (!session) return;

  ctx.drawImage(sumberGambar, 0, 0, INPUT_SIZE, INPUT_SIZE);
  const imgData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, INPUT_SIZE, INPUT_SIZE).data;

  // Konversi piksel ke Tensor Float32 [1, 3, 224, 224]
  const float32Data = new Float32Array(3 * INPUT_SIZE * INPUT_SIZE);
  const stride = INPUT_SIZE * INPUT_SIZE;

  for (let i = 0; i < stride; i++) {
    float32Data[i] = imgData[i * 4] / 255.0;             // R
    float32Data[stride + i] = imgData[i * 4 + 1] / 255.0; // G
    float32Data[2 * stride + i] = imgData[i * 4 + 2] / 255.0; // B
  }

  const inputTensor = new ort.Tensor("float32", float32Data, [1, 3, INPUT_SIZE, INPUT_SIZE]);
  const feeds = { [session.inputNames[0]]: inputTensor };

  const results = await session.run(feeds);
  const output = results[session.outputNames[0]].data;

  // Cari indeks kelas dengan probabilitas tertinggi
  let maxIdx = 0;
  let maxProb = output[0];
  for (let i = 1; i < output.length; i++) {
    if (output[i] > maxProb) {
      maxProb = output[i];
      maxIdx = i;
    }
  }

  const namaKelas = classMap[maxIdx] || `Kelas-${maxIdx}`;
  const persen = (maxProb * 100).toFixed(1);

  if (maxProb > 0.70) {
    const warna = namaKelas === "over_dimension" ? "red" : "green";
    hasilEl.innerHTML = `Terdeteksi: <b style="color:${warna}">${namaKelas}</b> (${persen}%)`;
  } else {
    hasilEl.innerText = `Tidak ada truk / Kurang yakin (${namaKelas}: ${persen}%)`;
  }
}

// Fungsi bantu untuk mengetes dengan Webcam laptop/HP
async function aktifkanWebcam() {
  const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: true });
  video.srcObject = stream;
}

// Fungsi bantu untuk mengetes dengan Upload Foto Truk
function tesUploadGambar(event) {
  const file = event.target.files[0];
  if (!file) return;
  const img = new Image();
  img.onload = () => jalankanPrediksi(img);
  img.src = URL.createObjectURL(file);
}

// Panggil saat halaman web dibuka
konekKeHuggingFace();
</script>
